children: MSCI will remove MSTR from major indexes after the November 30, 2026 close, citing eligibility rules. Strategy estimates potential share selling, while the stock remains Nasdaq-listed.
As of Nov. 8, MSTR held 850,364 Bitcoin bought for $64.16 billion, averaging $75,456 each. At $67,400 per Bitcoin, the holdings were worth $57.315 billion, an unrealized loss of $6.845 billion.
Strategy Inc Class A (MSTR) CEO Phong Le said on November 13 that about 3% of the company’s shares are linked to MSCI indexes and that the company expects little impact from the planned deletions.
JPMorgan held 848,932 MSTR shares worth about $131.3 million on Sept. 30, up 36% from June. Put options covered 1,148,500 shares, versus 715,700 previously.
The Swiss National Bank cut its MSTR holdings to 714,100 shares in Q3 2026 from 766,100 in Q1. Its position was valued at $109.3 million on Sept. 30.
Strategy (MSTR) joined the Bitcoin Security Consortium, formed in July by seven firms. Members pledged $15 million over three years, including funds for post-quantum cryptography research.
